commands.unavailable: the harness recorded no result for this command

state_meanings.stands: the field the decision filled reads today as it read in the commit that landed it
state_meanings.revised: the field changed after the decision landed; `revised_by` says by which commits and which route, and only `corrective` and `hand-edit` are a person disagreeing
state_meanings.node-gone: the node the decision located is no longer in the specification
state_meanings.unreadable: the located field could not be read at the landing commit — the log names a field the node did not hold when the entry was written
state_meanings.unlocated: no commit of the log contains this entry's text; the landing cannot be found

route_meanings.corrective: a /deliver-scope commit whose slug names a correction — corrective, hotfix, fix, abandon or revert — read as behavior contradicting the decision and a person routing the correction; the reading rests on the slug's words
route_meanings.framework: a /deliver-scope commit whose slug names no correction — the framework re-authoring the field
route_meanings.hand-edit: a commit no framework skill wrote — a person changed the artifact directly
